visualize_wrong_predictions: visualize incorrectly classified videos from a batch and write them to Tensorboard
pick_wrong_preds: pick wrong predictions by comparing model output against ground truth labels in a subset
get_wrong_class_names: get the list of class names the model predicted incorrectly across all batches
close_tensorboard_writer: close the Tensorboard writer to flush and clean up visualization resources
init_wrong_prediction_vis: initialize WrongPredictionVis with a config to track and visualize model misclassifications
